newsitem.title: SPAIN: Youths injure woman in Spain petrol bomb attack.
newsitem.headline: Youths injure woman in Spain petrol bomb attack.

text.p: A Spanish woman was seriously injured in the northerly Basque region on Thursday after five hooded attackers threw petrol bombs into the offices of a court, local government officials said.
The 51-year-old court secretary suffered severe burns to her face, arms and hands in the attack, which caught her as she was leaving the building in the town of Renteria.
Violence involving gangs of hooded youths with links to the Basque separatist group ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has risen sharply over the past six months, police say.
ETA has killed some 800 people in a 28-year drive for Basque independence.
